description: This header file declares external API functions for a Udp Ping Client object within the ANSC (Advanced Networking Service Container) system. It includes function prototypes for creating, removing, enrolling objects, and initializing the Udp Ping Client object.

methods.name: AnscUpcoCreate
methods.description: Creates an instance of the Udp Ping Client object with specified container, owner, and reserved contexts.

methods.name: AnscUpcoRemove
methods.description: Removes an instance of the Udp Ping Client object.

methods.name: AnscUpcoEnrollObjects
methods.description: Enrolls necessary objects within the Udp Ping Client object context.

methods.name: AnscUpcoInitialize
methods.description: Initializes the Udp Ping Client object.
